name: Malachi
summary: Last of the Old Testament prophets. Challenged a disillusioned community over corrupt worship, unfaithfulness in marriage and withheld tithes.

evidence.note: The rebuilt temple is functioning (Mal 1:10; 3:1, 10), so after 515.
The abuses he names (mixed marriages, neglected tithes) are those Nehemiah tackled (Neh 13), so before or around c. 433.

dating.notes: Most date Malachi to the Persian period between the temple's rebuilding and Nehemiah's reforms; exactly where is debated.
